name: Textarea
intent: Multi-line text entry for notes, descriptions and code, with its own label, hint, error and character count. Looks and behaves like Input.
usage: Use Textarea for text that runs over one line: notes, descriptions, messages, formulas. Pass label, hint, error and help as props, same as Input. size sets the starting height (100 / 180 / 240+ px); people can drag it taller. type code switches to a monospace font for formulas and snippets. maxLength shows a live count under the field. See contracts/textarea.json for the full contract.

label.note: Always set. With hideLabel it stays for screen readers only.

hideLabel.note: No visible label. Use only when the screen makes the purpose clear.

labelPosition.note: start puts the label in a 160px column beside the field, lined up with the first line.

size.note: Starting height 100 / 180 / 260 px. People can drag it taller.

type.note: code uses Roboto Mono 12px on a 24px line, for formulas and snippets.

placeholder.note: An example value. Never the only label.

required.note: Red asterisk before the label and the native required attribute.

invalid.note: Red border without a message. Prefer error.

error.note: Message under the field. Also turns the border red. Replaces hint.

help.note: Help icon beside the label. The text shows in a HelpPopover titled with the label, on hover, keyboard focus or click.

maxLength.note: Limits the length and shows a count like 120/500 under the field, on the right.

useWhen: Templates or code snippets (type code). For formulas with insert and check tools, use FormulaEditor.
doNot: Do not invent a local Field, FieldLabel, FieldError, CodeEditor or NotesBox.
Do not use for one-line values. Use Input.
Do not use for rich text or syntax highlighting. That is out of scope.
Do not add a formula toolbar above a Textarea. Use FormulaEditor.
Do not use a placeholder as the label.
a11y: A real label is tied to the textarea by id, visible or visually hidden with hideLabel.
hint, error, help and the counter are linked with aria-describedby.
error and invalid set aria-invalid. required sets the native required attribute; the asterisk is hidden from screen readers.
Focus shows a 2px brand ring around the field; red when invalid.
Disabled uses the native disabled attribute and cannot be resized.
snippet: <Textarea label="Notes" placeholder="Add a note for your team" maxLength={500} />
